title: Ink Word Defense
description: Deploy and upgrade ink-calligraphy defense towers across a scroll battlefield to hold back escalating waves of shadowy invaders.
controls: Tap build tiles to place and upgrade word towers along the winding lane, and spend earned gold to strengthen your defense.

zh-CN.title: 文字塔防
zh-CN.description: 极简国风创意文字塔防：在卷轴战场上排兵布阵、构筑特色文字炮塔并合成升级，迎战一波波文字军团入侵。
zh-CN.controls: 点击地图空位建造并升级各类文字防御塔，合理搭配技能与阵型抵御全部波次进攻。
